title: From KPI Visibility to Decision Rights: Making AI Operations Governable
title_zh: 从 KPI 可见性到决策权：让 AI 运营真正可治理
coreProposition: Measurement becomes governance only when a visible signal reaches an accountable decision point that can trigger corrective action and closure.
uniqueVisualMetaphor: A precise aircraft operations indicator light illuminating a physical decision lever in an airport operations environment, with the lever connected to a resolved pathway rather than a screen.
primarySubject: One illuminated operational indicator and one authoritative physical decision lever
composition: Landscape 16:9, indicator in foreground, lever as dominant central subject, subtle airport infrastructure depth in background; no screens; strong directional light implies a decision threshold.
palette: Midnight blue, brushed aluminum, clean white highlights, restrained amber and teal operational light
style: Premium editorial technology photography, realistic aviation operations atmosphere, cinematic but sober, low information density
